# stalwart_mta_tls_strategy (Data Source)

Defines a TLS security strategy for outbound connections.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Short identifier for the TLS strategy

### Read-Only

- `allow_invalid_certs` (Boolean) Whether to allow connections to servers with invalid TLS certificates
- `dane` (String) Whether DANE is required, optional, or disabled
- `description` (String) A short description of the TLS strategy, which can be used to identify it in the list of strategies
- `mta_sts` (String) Whether MTA-STS is required, optional, or disabled
- `mta_sts_timeout` (Number) Maximum time to wait for the MTA-STS policy lookup to complete
- `start_tls` (String) Whether TLS support is required, optional, or disabled
- `tls_timeout` (Number) Maximum time to wait for the TLS handshake to complete
